description: A single hash-only content item co-hashed under sha2-256 AND blake2b-256. Pins that a two-entry hashes map encodes deterministically — canonical CBOR sorts sha2-256 before blake2b-256 by length-first key order, so the encoded bytes are independent of the input order — and that the digests derive from the content. Cross-SDK byte oracle for the co-hash producer path (the SDK publish_prehashed / seal co-hash helpers build the identical item).
